name: Notion VTec Berhad
overview: Notion VTec 今年以土地交易为主：子公司 Notion International (M) Sdn Bhd 拟以 RM27,316,800 出售一块位于 Johor Bahru 的空置永久工业地；另一子公司 Bentong Resources Sdn Bhd 以 RM29,620,800 完成收购一块位于 Klang 的空置永久农业地。业务板块层面未见产能扩张、新业务或合约公告。
overview_en: Notion VTec's activities this year centred on land transactions: subsidiary Notion International (M) Sdn Bhd proposed to dispose of a vacant freehold industrial land in Johor Bahru for RM27,316,800, while subsidiary Bentong Resources Sdn Bhd completed the acquisition of a vacant freehold agriculture land in Klang for RM29,620,800. No capacity expansion, new business or contract announcements were made at the business segment level.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年公告主要涉及子公司层面的土地出售与收购，未涉及具体业务板块的运营变化。
segments.note_en: This year's announcements mainly involved land disposal and acquisition at subsidiary level, with no operational changes to specific business segments.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Notion International (M) Sdn Bhd 与 Heptagon Photonics Malaysia Sdn Bhd 签订买卖协议，以 RM27,316,800 出售位于 Johor Bahru 的一块空置永久工业地。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Notion International (M) Sdn Bhd entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Heptagon Photonics Malaysia Sdn Bhd to dispose of a vacant freehold industrial land in Johor Bahru for RM27,316,800.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述农业地收购已完成，卖方律师确认收到余额购地款。
actions.text_en: The above agriculture land acquisition was completed, with the vendor's solicitors confirming receipt of the balance purchase price.
